program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (full-col? c)
      (all? (lambda (r) (= (cell-at g r c) 5)) (range 0 h)))
    (define divider (first (filter full-col? (range 0 w))))
    (define left-cells
      (filter
        (lambda (p)
          (let ((v (third p))) (and (< (second p) divider) (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 5)))))
        (grid-cells g)))
    (define (mirror-value r c)
      (let ((src
              (find-first
                (lambda (p)
                  (and (= r (first p)) (= c (+ divider (- divider (second p))))))
                left-cells)))
        (if src (third src) #f)))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((mv (mirror-value r c)))
          (if mv mv (cell-at g r c)))))))
